vacancy.title: Project Management and Engineering for Orbital Projects
vacancy.assessment: Direct onsite ESA/ESTEC position coordinating ESA Academy orbital CubeSat, ISS and Space Rider projects across design, PDR/CDR/FAR, AIT, launch and operations. Strong MSc engineering/project ownership and TU Delft Lunar Zebro plus ESA Academy experience fit; offers unusually good ESA network and a project-management transition. Requires 4+ years relevant experience and significant formal PM/stakeholder coordination. Vacancy is labelled temporary: confirm contract length, actual project placement and compensation before applying.
